title: Storyseam media cache (.storyseam/media.json)
description: Local reference path -> how the configured provider fetches it. On Higgsfield that is a confirmed media_id (upload -> PUT -> confirm); on Atlas and fal it is the public URL the file was published to. Written by /cast, read by /render and bin/asset-audit.sh. An entry whose mtime is older than the file on disk is stale.

^(assets|renders)/.+$.description: Either a Higgsfield {media_id, confirmed} or a URL provider's {url}. mtime lets the audit flag a file edited after registration.
